messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT P0 - elevated 5xx and tail latency from kv-prefetch path hitting hosted API. Affected routes: /v1/generate (all regions). Autoscale healthy but error rate spikes at 3:05 UTC. Paging eng-oncall-jordan and sre-lead-kate :rotating_light:
eng-oncall-jordan: saw the alert. I’m paging oncall and joining bridge. brief: 5xxs correlate with high cardinality prefix reads causing backend prefetch saturation, downstream DB timeouts.
sre-lead-kate: on bridge. can we identify a tenant blast radius? any heavy keys?
carla-reliability: telemetry: top hot prefixes show tenant:t-9a3 and tenant:t-11f, 78% of prefetched reads in last 10m. tail latency aligns with KV prefetch queue growth.
mike-platform: if prefetch queue is starving workers, we can throttle prefetch and short-circuit cold-prefetch. propose two live mitigations: 1) global prefetch disable (fast but higher cold-latency), 2) graceful deopt: reduce prefetch concurrency per-tenant and enforce per-tenant token quota. prefer 2 for customer impact.
eng-oncall-jordan: agree. start with per-tenant prefetch concurrency cap at 1 for tenants > 10k rps and drop global prefetch for unknown keys. applying rule now.
leo-runtime: pushing config patch to routing: ``PATCH /admin/config/prefetch HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "mode": "graceful_deopt",
  "per_tenant_concurrency_cap": 1,
  "hotkey_threshold": 10000,
  "fallback": "serve-from-origin-without-prefetch"
}``
eng-oncall-jordan: applied. logs show prefetch queue depth dropping. error rate decreased from 6.1% -> 2.2% in 4m. continuing to monitor.
sre-lead-kate: nice. next step: carveout emergency tenant-level quota for the two heavy tenants and reroute their traffic to dedicated path to avoid impacting others. Carla — can you open tenant shield for t-9a3 and t-11f?
carla-reliability: done: tenant shield enabled. moved t-9a3 to dedicated routing group with prefetch disabled. commands: ``/admin/tenants/shield t-9a3 --route=dedicated --prefetch=off``
cust-success-anna: FYI reached out to t-11f SRE lead, they saw degraded responses earlier. I'm drafting a message explaining mitigations and expected short cold-latency increase.
mike-platform: adding short-term rate-sculpt on public route: reduce per-ip RPS to 8 for generation route to smooth bursty fanout. config: ``/admin/rls/set --route "/v1/generate" --per_ip_rps=8 --window=60s`` applied.
leo-runtime: telemetry now: 5xx -> 0.9%, p95 latency back within SLOs, but p99 elevated for prefetched cold misses.
sre-lead-kate: keep prefetch graceful_deopt in place for 30m, then reassess. if stable, we'll roll a targeted prefetch algorithm fix and a longer-term quota automation.
eng-oncall-jordan: will stay on call for handover. scheduling oncall-handoff to night team in 40m. also raising incident to SEV on duty for postmortem.
carla-reliability: capturing timeline + config diffs. saving snapshot: ``/admin/snapshots/create --name=kv-prefetch-deopt-171950``
cust-success-anna: sent customer note to t-11f and t-9a3: brief, we implemented targeted shielding and are monitoring. suggested mitigation steps for them if they see issues.
sre-lead-kate: postmortem owners: leo-runtime (runtime fix), carla-reliability (mitigations + telemetry), mike-platform (rate limiting automation), eng-oncall-jordan (oncall coordination).
eng-oncall-jordan: handing off to night team in #eng-oncall-handoff. leaving bridge open for 1h. :white_check_mark: 
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE - mitigations applied: graceful prefetch deopt, tenant shields for t-9a3/t-11f, per-ip RLS on /v1/generate. Current status: degraded -> stabilizing.
eng-oncall-jordan: closing thread here; will follow up with postmortem doc and retention links. thanks all for quick triage. :pray:
